name: beautiful-cli
description: Write, review, port, and enforce idiomatic cross-platform CLI and TUI tools on TypeScript + Node: three skills distilled from the facta CLI handbook, the POSIX CLI conventions, and the Ink documentation, plus a drop-in eslint config.

interface.longDescription:
Three skills for command-line and TUI developers on TypeScript + Node, distilled from the facta CLI handbook, the POSIX CLI conventions, and the Ink documentation.

cli-best-practices guides new CLI code: one headless core with TUI, print, JSON and stream-json frontends; stdout as data and stderr as diagnostics; a stable exit-code contract; TTY-aware behavior; the terminal lifecycle guard; untrusted-text sanitization; cross-platform paths, shells and signals; and the unbreakable layer contract.

cli-review reviews a command, parser, output path, TUI, or diff and returns a prioritized report. Architecture and stream/exit contracts rank above everything. Every finding cites a file and line, the rule it breaks, and the smallest fix.

cli-port ports POSIX shell scripts, legacy Node scripts, Click/Typer/cobra/commander CLIs, or a web flow to a structured TypeScript CLI with the same behavior. It ports the original tests first and writes a PORTING.md.

The skills contain instructions and reference text only. They make no network calls and collect no data. When a Node.js toolchain is available, the skills run tsc, eslint, and vitest on your project; without one, they work from the code alone. A drop-in eslint config is available in the GitHub repository.
capabilities: Port scripts and legacy CLIs with the same behavior
defaultPrompt: Review this CLI's exit codes and output paths
Port this bash script to a structured TypeScript CLI
Design the print and JSON modes for this command

publication.release_notes: Initial release: three CLI skills, the headless-core and stream contract, and a proven eslint config.
